messages:
sara (support): FYI customer saw TLS handshake errors for internal service after yesterday's cert rotation. Root error: "SSL: certificate subject name 'service.external.company.com' does not match target 'svc.auth.internal'". Ticket #INC-8342
aj (eng-sre): Can you paste the failing curl and a dig from the customer's VPC please?
sara (support): From customer VPC (they pasted output):
```
$ dig @10.10.0.2 svc.auth.internal +short
10.2.3.4
$ curl -v https://svc.auth.internal/ --resolve svc.auth.internal:443:10.2.3.4
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1):
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2):
* SSL: certificate subject name 'service.external.company.com' does not match target 'svc.auth.internal'
```
mike (eng-platform): We rotated the prod cert yesterday (deploy-bot: cert-rotation v2026-03-15). The new cert only includes SANs for service.external.company.com and api.external.company.com — internal hostnames weren't added.
aj (eng-sre): That explains the hostname mismatch, but why is the client resolving svc.auth.internal to 10.2.3.4? That IP belongs to prod-private subnet where the internal service runs. Is there a split-horizon mismatch with private hosted zones?
sara (support): Customer says DNS was fine before rotation. I checked our Route53 cross-account setup — I see two private hosted zones with the same zone name 'auth.internal.company.com': ZHSTAGING111 (assoc: staging-vpc-ids) and ZPROD222 (assoc: prod-vpc-ids). The resolver rule in the customer's account points to account-prod forwarder; might be hitting the staging zone due to resolver rule priority.
mike (eng-platform): Aha. Also saw that during the cert rollout we updated certs in prod but not in staging. If some VPC resolves to the staging hosted zone IP or a stale A record (10.2.3.100), clients can get a different backend serving old certs or certs with external names.
aj (eng-sre): Repro steps to confirm:
1) From prod VPC: dig @10.10.0.2 svc.auth.internal +short -> expecting 10.2.3.4
2) curl --resolve svc.auth.internal:443:10.2.3.4 https://svc.auth.internal/ -v -> check server cert CN/SAN
3) From peered VPC with resolver rule -> ensure the resolve path goes to the correct hosted zone account

Please run `aws route53 list-hosted-zones-by-name --dns-name "auth.internal.company.com"` and `aws route53 get-hosted-zone --id ZPROD222` to check records.
sara (support): Customer ran that and found two A records: in ZPROD222 A -> 10.2.3.4 (new cert backend), in ZHSTAGING111 A -> 10.2.3.4 as well but served by a different service instance with old cert (external CN). Looks like two different services behind same IP but different cert. Very confusing.
aj (eng-sre): Possible root causes:
- Cert rotation removed internal SANs (we saw that).
- Split-horizon: resolver rules and VPC associations caused different VPCs to hit different backend pools (staging vs prod) or stale instances.
- Route53 replication/record drift across accounts after migration.
mike (eng-platform): Immediate mitigations:
- Roll back cert rotation to include internal SANs (fastest short-term) OR
- Add an ALIAS/CNAME in the prod private hosted zone that maps the external name to internal IP so hostname matches cert (not ideal)
- Reconcile hosted zones: ensure only ZPROD222 is associated with prod VPCs, update resolver rules to prefer prod forwarder.

Action items:
- aj: validate which VPCs are associated with ZHSTAGING111 and remove prod VPC associations if present. (ETA 1h)
- mike: coordinate cert rollback or reissue to include internal SANs (ETA 2h)
- customer-ops: apply temporary DNS fix (add CNAME service.external.company.com -> svc.auth.internal) in prod private zone if needed (ETA 30m)
- sara: keep customer updated and collect logs.

customer-ops: I can push the CNAME to the prod zone now and inform customer to retry.
sara (support): Customer retried after CNAME patch: curl now succeeds but warns about revalidation in some clients that pin SPKI. They want a durable fix.
aj (eng-sre): After CNAME patch, still need to reconcile hosted zones and fix certs. I'll remove the stray assoc on ZHSTAGING111 and confirm propagation.

deploy-bot: cert-rotation rollback started (job id: rollback-2026-03-15-457)
mike (eng-platform): I'll reissue prod cert with both external and internal SANs and push rotation once verified.
sara (support): Customer confirmed the service is back for now. Keeping ticket open until prod cert reissued and hosted zone cleaned.

(STATUS) last update: rolling cert reissue in progress; resolver assoc cleanup scheduled.
